10-Year-Old Girl Abducted, Raped, and Murdered in Delhi; Accused Arrested

A 10-year-old girl was abducted from a footpath in Delhi where she was sleeping with her family, then raped and murdered. The accused, identified as a cab driver, has been arrested in connection with the crime. Reports indicate the girl cried out for help, calling for her father, during the incident. Her father reportedly pursued the abductor but was unable to intervene.
